messages:
viv: FYI opened PR to add a compact troubleshooting section for 429s + context trimming; includes example snippets and a tiny repro script. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1422

hao: I can handle the HTTP header parsing examples. Will add both 'Retry-After' parsing (seconds + HTTP-date) and a fallback 'X-Retry-After' header we occasionally set internally.

mike: i'll add a minimal node + python sdk snippet showing backoff + trimContext helper. Keeping examples intentionally short for copy/paste.

ci-bot: markdown-lint: MD013 line-length: line 34

viv: thanks CI — will wrap long lines. @eng-oncall can we run the docs smoke workflow against dev stack tomorrow morning? need to validate the curl loop repro.

eng-oncall: yes, we can allow a temporary dev quota bump for 2 hours. schedule and ping ops.

hao: pushed header parsing util: parseRetryAfter(value) -> ms. Notes: if header looks like HTTP-date, Date.parse works; otherwise parse int seconds. Also added fallback to exponential jitter.

mike: snippets pushed: node (undici), fetch, python (requests). Example flow: detect 429 -> parse RA -> sleep -> if still 429, call trimContext() -> retry -> escalate to fallback small model after N failures.

viv: merging in ~1h unless anyone objects. Leaving checklist in PR description: anchors updated, snippets added, lint green, canary job drafted.

ci-bot: lint passed. link-checker: 1 external link flagged (line 112).

viv: I'll replace with archive link. merging now.

eng-oncall: scheduled temporary quota bump for 07:00 UTC tomorrow for the docs smoke run.

viv: merged. follow-ups: create issue for redirect mapping and add short release note to console. thanks all.
